Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma will open the batting for India Women. Hayley Jensen will begin the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then! India Women need 252 runs to win from 50 overs! They do have a good chance to win the final ODI of the game and end the series on a high. Will India Women come out on top? Or will New Zealand Women defend this total to register a clean sweep? We'll find out in a short while.

Sneh Rana (9-0-40-2) comes up for a quick chat. Says that she is very happy with the bowling unit as it bowled according to the plan and field placement. Adds that there wasn't much spin and she bowled to her strength. Tells that she's glad to pick up the wickets of Sophie Devine and Lauren Down.

New Zealand Women could not get a healthy score this time. Throughout the series, they have been exceptional with the bat, but today it was the Indian bowlers who came out on top. After opting to bat first, they did get to a good start, but they could not capitalize on the same. Amelia Kerr once again was the top batter as she continued her good form and scored 66 vital runs but could not carry on till the end. Every time New Zealand Women tried to build a partnership, they were put on the back foot. It is now time for the bowlers to deliver their best and defend this total.

It was all spin doing the magic for Indian Women! All the spinners were right on cue. They kept the New Zealand batters in check and did not let them score freely and grabbed wickets at regular intervals. Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Sneh Rana, and Deepti Sharma grabbed 2 wickets each and made sure not to leak runs in their spells, while Poonam Yadav also managed to scalp a wicket and was economical as well. This has been one of India's best bowling performances in this series, and they do have a golden opportunity to end this series on a positive note.

India Women will be the happier side at the end of the first half of the match. They put up a great show with the ball and did not let New Zealand Women get away with a big score this time. The White Ferns just could not get going towards the backend of the innings and they have managed to put a par total of 251.

OUT! Run out on the final ball. Tossed up, full and around off, Mair uses her feet and drives it down to long off. They attempt for an impossible second run, the throw comes to the bowler who turns and breaks the stumps. The third umpire is referred and the replays show that Hannah Rowe is short of the crease. That will be it then, New Zealand Women finish on 251/9.
Is that a run out? There is a throw at the bowler's end. The replay rolls and shows that Hannah Rowe was short of her crease. OUT says the third umpire!
250 up! Loopy and full outside off, Rowe drills her drive down to long off for just a run.
Full and wide outside off, Mair walks across the stumps and sweeps it to short 45 for a quick run.
Loopy and full around off, Rowe fails to get underneath this one and only pushes it down to long on for a single.
SIX! That's dispatched! Full in length around off, Hannah Rowe gives the charge and clobbers it over long on for a biggie.
Swing and a miss! Full and floated outside off, turning away, Hannah Rowe tries to slog-sweep but misses.
Drags her length short and delivers it on middle, Mair pulls but finds mid-wicket.
Slower through the air, full and around off, Mair walks down the track but scuffs her attempted shot off the inner edge to mid-wicket.
Fullish and around off, Rowe hammers it down to long off for a single.
Fuller and around off, forced down to long off for a run.
FOUR! That's how you sweep it! Quicker and flatter around leg, Rosemary Mair kneels and nails her sweep shot past short fine leg for a boundary.
Full and around middle, it's nudged in the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Rosemary Mair walks in next. Also, Sneh Rana will bowl the penultimate over of the innings!

OUT! Timber! Tossed up, landing around middle and leg, Frances Mackay shuffles across the stumps and tries to sweep it across the line but misses. It goes past her pads and strikes the leg stump. Rajeshwari Gayakwad has two now and India Women are doing a great job in the end overs.
Full and outside off, driven to covers.
FOUR! Shot! Full and floated, around middle, Frances Mackay makes room and drills it through covers for a boundary.
Tossed up, around middle and leg, again Frances Mackay tries to reverse sweep but misses. She is hit on the pads but nothing from the umpire after the appeal is made for an lbw.
Shout for an lbw! Loopy and full around off, Frances Mackay mistimes her reverse-batted shot towards the keeper. The impact is outside off if that has pinged her on the pads.
Tossed up, around off, Hannah Rowe gets back and works it to square leg for a brisk single.
Uses her feet and lofts it over mid off. The ball drops in front of the fielder in the deep and they get a single.
Walks forward and across to flick it on the leg side but misses. It goes off Frances' pads to short third man and they cross for a leg bye.
Flat and full outside off, Rowe uses her feet and squeezes it out through point for a single.
Short and wide outside off, played to point. Another dot.
Play and a miss! Slower through the air, full and outside off Rowe tries to sweep but misses.
Fuller and on off, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Play and a miss! Fuller in length and outside off, Rowe attempts to drive but misses.
Hannah Rowe walks out to bat.

OUT! Hayley Jensen holes out after playing a lovely hand with the bat. Full and floated around off, Jansen goes down and tries to power her slog-sweep into the stand at mid-wicket. She fails to get the desired elevation and Jhulan Goswami takes a simple catch in the deep. Rajeshwari Gayakwad has her first wicket of the match.
Commentary.Howout: c Jhulan Goswami b Rajeshwari Gayakwad

Commentary.Commentary: Steps back to a full ball around off and lofts it over covers for a couple of runs.
On middle and leg, worked to square leg for a run.
Quicker and fuller on middle, defended back.
Loopy and on middle, it's clipped in the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Tosses this one up, full and on middle, Frances Mackay knocks it down towards the right of the bowler. Deepti Sharma makes a good diving stop there!
Short in length, outside off. Hayley Jensen punches it towards cover off the back foot for a single.
DROPPED! A flatter ball, outside off, quicker one. Hayley Jensen stays in her crease and looks to cut this, but gets a slight bottom edge towards the keeper. Richa Ghosh fails to grab this one.
Full in length, around middle. Frances Mackay advances down and eases it to long on for a single.
Shorter ball, outside off. Hayley Jensen, on the back foot, cuts it towards cover for a single.
Spinning it in, shorter ball, on middle. Hayley Jensen pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller ball, outside off. Frances Mackay steps down and defends it out.
Quicker one, shorter, outside off. Hayley Jensen cuts it towards cover for a single.
Flighted and full around off, Hayley strokes it to the right of the bowler who does well to stop it with a dive.
FOUR! Bang! It's been a great little knock from Hayley Jensen thus far. Full and around middle, Hayley sits down on one knee and powers her sweep shot in front of square leg for a boundary.
Loopy ball, full in length, on middle. Frances Mackay knocks it down to long on for a single.
Tosses it up, on middle, Frances Mackay blocks it out.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad is back into the attack. 0/36 in her 6 overs so far.
Fuller ball, on middle. Frances Mackay steps down and works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Yorker-length delivery, slower through the air, on middle. Frances Mackay digs it out towards point.
Quicker, no turn on that, outside off. Frances Mackay looks to cut this but misses.
Loopy ball now, full again, around off. Hayley Jensen sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller now, on middle. Frances Mackay eases it towards long on for a single.
Shorter ball, quicker. Frances Mackay pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Great placement. Nice way to end the over. Short in length and outside off, Hayley Jensen goes on the back foot and hammer-pulls it to the wide long on fence.
Googly, short and wide outside off, Hayley punches but finds the cover fielder.
Tosses it up, full, on middle, Frances Mackay steps down the pitch and knocks it down to long on for a single.
A leg spinner, around middle. Hayley Jensen pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter ball, around off. Hayley Jensen punches it towards cover.
FOUR! Well played! Loopy ball, full and outside off. Hayley Jensen gets down on her knee and slog-sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. 200 up!
Quicker one, around middle. Hayley Jensen gets a leading edge towards covers for a single.
Fuller ball, around middle. Frances Mackay works it away towards deep mid-wicket once again for a single.
Shorter now, around middle. Hayley Jensen knocks it to deep mid-wicket and rotates the strike!
Slower through the air, loopy ball. Frances Mackay steps down and works it away towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full again, on middle. Frances Mackay taps it towards the leg side. Deepti Sharma cuts it out. No run there!
Loopy ball, full, outside off. Hayley Jensen pushes it towards covers for a single.
Powerplay 3 time. One extra fielder, i.e. 5 can now be put outside the 30-yard circle till the end of this inning. Deepti Sharma is back on now.
Loopy and full around off, Frances Mackay walks forward and drives it to extra cover. Maiden!
Googly again, short and outside off, Mackay cuts but finds the fielder at covers again.
Another dot as it has been pushed with the spin to covers.
A low full toss around leg, Frances tries to flick but gets a leading edge to cover-point.
Googly, around off, Frances Mackay tries to defend but gets an inside edge on the leg side.
Floated and around off, Frances Mackay pushes it down to mid on.
Loopy and full around off, it's defended back to the bowler.
Short and wide outside off, Hayley Jensen again tries to cut but misses.
Beaten! This one goes straight on after landing on a fuller length outside off, Hayley plays inside the line and is beaten.
FOUR! Bang! Short in length and outside off, Hayley Jensen rocks on the back foot and slaps it through backward point for a cracking boundary.
Clips a full ball to mid-wicket and takes a single.
Tossed up on middle, blocked back.
Around off, fuller in length, defended off the front foot.
Fullish and on off, defended to covers.
Presses forward to a full ball and pushes it to covers.
Loopy and full around middle, it's chipped past the diving mid on fielder for a single.
Fuller and on middle, bunted to mid on.
Frances Mackay comes to the crease now.
Uppish but wide of the bowler. Full and flighted outside off, Hayley Jensen drives it aerially but wide of Yadav. It goes to long off and they cross.

OUT! LBW! Sneh Rana has her revenge immediately. A lovely off spinner, landing full around off and turning back in a bit, Lauren Down is stuck inside the crease as she attempts to work it on the leg side. She misses and is rapped on the pads. The finger goes up immediately after the appeal for an lbw is made. End of a promising knock from Down.
SIX! High and handsome! Full and around off, turning in, Lauren Down bends her back knee and muscles it over mid-wicket for a maximum.
Fuller and around off, Lauren covers the line and blocks it back.
Fullish and outside off, eased to long off for a single.
Short in length and around off, it's pushed out back to the bowler.
Flatter and shorter around off, Down pushes it from the back foot to covers for one.
Short again, outside off and spinning away slowly, Hayley Jensen plays late but finds point. Successful over for Yadav.
A touch short and outside off, pushed to covers.
Flighted and around off, lofted down to long on for one.
Full again, around off, knocked down to long off for a single.
Fuller and around off, pushed to covers.
Hayley Jensen comes in to bat.

OUT! Caught behind! Soft dismissal for Katey Martyn and Poonam Yadav is all smiles. The 38-run stand is broken before it could become dangerous. Slower through the air, landing full and around off, Katey Martin goes down to power it over the leg side but is way too early into the shot. The ball takes the top edge and loops behind the keeper. Richa Ghosh makes no mistake.
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Poonam Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller ball, around middle. Lauren Down steps down and nudges it towards mid-wicket. Jhulan Goswami runs and dives to her left and makes a good stop.
Quicker one, outside off. Lauren Down stays back and looks to push it towards point but misses.
FOUR! Nicely done! Slower ball, full and on middle. Lauren Down sweeps it towards deep square leg for a boundary.
Spinning it in, on middle. Lauren Down is cramped for room there and ends up blocking it.
Quicker now, outside off. Katey Martin stays in her crease and slashes it past point. Rajeshwari Gayakwad chases the ball and does well the keep the ball away from the ropes. Three runs taken!
Tosses it up, full and around off. Katey Martin blocks it out towards point.
Sneh Rana is back for another spell. 5-0-13-1 are her bowling figures thus far.
Full again, slower, on middle, Lauren Down nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Fuller ball, around off. Katey Martin reverse-sweeps this towards backward point and scampers through to the other end.
Slower through the air, loopy ball, full and outside off. Katey Martin waits for it and tries to cut this one, but misses.
Quicker one, short again, outside off. Katey Martin cuts it to point.
Outside off, shorter. Katey Martin punches it towards cover.

FOUR! Just over! A loopy ball, full and outside off. Katey Martin lifts it just over the fielder at mid off, who jumps and tries to get there but fails. The ball races away towards the long off fence for a boundary.
SIX! Clean strike! Very full again, around middle. Lauren Down waits for it and tonks it over long on for a biggie!
Full again, around middle. Lauren Down lifts it over the bowler's head, towards long off for a brace.
An appeal for LBW, but not given! Full again, coming back in, on the pads. Katey Martin looks to flick but misses. The ball deflects off the pads and goes towards point. A leg bye is taken!
Pitches this one up, outside off. Lauren Down drives it towards deep cover for a single.
Tad fuller, outside off. Katey Martin shuffles across, tries to scoop this, the ball goes off the inside edge towards deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, nipping back in, around off. Lauren Down looks to drive but gets an inside edge towards fine leg. Single taken!
Fuller ball, on middle. Lauren Down lifts it towards the fielder at long on who collects it on the bounce. Single taken!
Tosses this one up, outside off. Katey Martin knocks it to long off for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off, slower through the air. Lauren Down steps down the pitch and lifts it over cover for a single.
Wide! Spinning it away, wide of off. Lauren Down leaves it alone. Wide called!
Slower through the air, outside off. Lauren Down stays in her crease and pushes it to the fielder at cover-point.
Tosses this one up, outside off, full in length. Katey Martin sweeps this but gets a thick top edge towards short fine leg. The keeper runs to her left and keeps it to a single.
Loopy ball, turning it away, outside off. Lauren Down cuts it past cover-point for a single.
Poonam Yadav is brought back into the attack.
Around off, on a length, it's guided down to third man for a single.
Full and angling down the leg side, Martin fails to flick and it goes off her pads to square leg for a leg bye.
Fuller now, outside off. Lauren Down drives it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Lauren Down stays in the crease and looks to cut this, but gets an under edge towards the keeper.

Direct hit...but Katey Martin is safe! A fuller ball, outside off. Katey Martin taps it towards covers and scampers through to the other end. The fielder there collects the ball and throws it directly on the stumps at the striker's end. The square leg umpire says not out! Does not even send it up! The replays later found out that Katey Martin had not landed her bat and her foot was on the line. Gets away there!
Fuller ball, outside off. Katey Martin pushes it towards cover. No run there!

DRINKS! India Women have fought back well and have got rid of the set batters. They will be hoping they capitalize on the same and continue to pick up regular wickets to not let New Zealand Women get away with a big score. Jhulan Goswami is back for her second spell.
Serves it full and around off, Lauren walks forward and drives but finds the fielder at covers.
Shout for a caught behind, not given. Slow turn away from the batter, Lauren Down stays back to force it through the line but misses.
Full and around off, driven to covers.
Loopy and full, around leg, Martin sweeps it down to fine leg and picks up three runs to open her account.
Uses her feet and pushes it to the right of point for a single.
Flighted and on off, turning away, Lauren goes back and taps it down to point.
Flatter and on off, Martin defends it from the back foot.
Katey Martin walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! That's a massive breakthrough for India Women. The set batter is gone and it's Amelia Kerr who has been a big thorn in their flesh in this series. Full and floated outside off, going straight on after landing, Kerr goes down to slog-sweep it across the line but gets a top edge. It flies towards point, Richa Ghosh calls for it as she runs across to her right and takes the catch safely. End of another fabulous knock from Amelia Kerr.
Commentary.Howout: c Richa Ghosh b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Floated and around off, Kerr goes down and paddles it wide of Jhulan Goswami at short fine leg for a couple of runs.
Shout for an lbw, not given! Loopy and around middle, turning down, Down tries to flick but misses. It goes off her pads to the leg side and they cross for a leg bye.
Tossed up, close to off, Down pushes it to the right of the bowler.
Full and flighted on off, Down drives but finds the fielder at covers.
Fuller and on middle, it's eased in front of square leg for one.
Short and wide outside off, cut through point for a single.
False shot! Amelia Kerr jumps down the track to flick it on the leg side but gets a leading edge. The ball falls safely at covers.
Full and around off, driven to point.
Beaten! Slower through the air, it lands around off and turns away with some good bounce, the batter hangs back to cut but is beaten.
Fuller and on off, driven to mid off.
Outside off, pushed firmly to covers where it's stopped well.
Loopy and around off, Kerr sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Turning down the leg side, Down tickles it through square leg and opens her account with a single.
Flighted and on middle, Kerr tucks it past the mid-wicket fielder for a single.
Uses the spin and works it to mid-wicket, not in the gap though.
FOUR! Well played! A touch short and around off, turning in, Amelia Kerr uses the depth of the crease to make room and whacks it through covers for a boundary.
Walks forward to a full ball and drives it to covers. Remains on nought.
Loopy and around off, Down pushes it to backward point.
Slightly quicker and fuller on off, it's defended from the back foot by Lauren.
Floated and around leg, Lauren pushes it away off her pads to mid-wicket.
Flighted and outside off, Down allows it through to the keeper.
Fuller and outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Shorter again, on middle. Amelia Kerr knocks it to long on for a single. End of a successful over for Deepti Sharma!

Deepti Sharma drops it short now, on middle. Amelia Kerr pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. Smriti Mandhana sprints to her right, dives, and keeps the ball away from the ropes! Another good stop! Two taken!
Lauren Down walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Deepti Sharma comes into the attack and strikes! A much-needed wicket for India Women! A loopy ball, full and outside off, once again, Amy Satterthwaite gets down to sweep this but does so with the bottom half of her bat. No timing on that as well. The ball flies straight towards Sneh Rana at deep mid-wicket who pouches it safely! New Zealand Women lose their third wicket!
Commentary.Howout: c Sneh Rana b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, quicker on this occasion. Amy Satterthwaite cuts it towards point. No run taken!
Fuller ball again, around off. Amelia Kerr sweeps it to deep square leg and rotates the strike.
Fuller ball, slower through the air, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Deepti Sharma is back on. 0/14 in her 3 overs so far.
Loopy ball, full and around middle, Amy Satterthwaite knocks it down to long on for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. Shafali Verma runs towards her right, dives, and makes a good stop there! Two runs taken!
Slower through the air, fuller again, outside off. Amy blocks it towards mid-wicket.
Outside off, fuller ball. Amy Satterthwaite closes the face of her bat and blocks it towards square leg.
Shorter ball, outside off. Amelia Kerr stays back and slashes it past point for three runs. 50 for Amelia Kerr! She just cannot stop scoring runs! Another fine inning!
Tosses it up, around off. Amelia Kerr blocks it out.
Fuller ball, on middle. Amelia Kerr eases it down past mid off for a single.
Quicker now, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite punches it towards deep point for a single.

Beaten! Loopy ball, turning it away, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite gets down to sweep but gets beaten as the ball spins away from her. The fielders did look excited! There might be a little bottom edge on it, but the keeper fails to grab it!
Much fuller now, slower through the air, on middle. Amy Satterthwaite eases it down to mid off.
Quicker now, short and outside off, Amelia Kerr pushes it towards cover for single.
Fuller ball, slower through the air, on middle. Amelia Kerr nudges it towards mid-wicket.
Short in length, outside off. Amelia Kerr cuts it towards deep cover for a single.
FOUR! Top shot! Much fuller now, around middle. Amelia Kerr gets low and sweeps it towards deep backward square leg for a boundary.
Short again, some extra bounce there, outside off. Amelia Kerr stays deep in her crease and cuts it uppishly towards point.
Quicker this time, short in length. Amelia Kerr stays back and cuts it towards cover.
Another loopy ball, full and outside off. Amelia Kerr steps down the pitch and lifts it over mid off for a couple of runs.
Tosses it up, outside off, turning it away. Amelia Kerr drives it towards the fielder at cover!
Slower this time, outside off. Amy leans and defends it out.
Outside off, shorter ball, Amelia Kerr pushes it towards cover off the back foot for a single.
Turning it in on middle, a tad shorter. Amelia Kerr flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Flatter ball, short and outside off. Amy Satterthwaite pushes it towards deep cover for a single.
Sneh Rana goes 'round the wicket, serves a fuller ball, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite stays back and tries to cut this away but misses.
Quicker one, shorter and on middle. Amelia Kerr works it away towards square leg for a single.
Turning away from the left-hander, Amy Satterthwaite allows it through to the keeper.

FOUR! Great placement! Too full and around off, Amy Satterthwaite bends her back knee and heaves it over mid-wicket. The connection is nice and it bisects the two fielders in the deep to find the fence.
Fuller and around leg, nudged off the pads to the leg side.
Aerial but safe! Poonam Yadav hurls across a loopy ball on off, some extra bounce, Amelia Kerr top-edges her attempted sweep shot but it falls safely at square leg. They cross.
Loopy and around off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
Slow spin away from the batter, on the shorter side, Kerr punches it to covers.
Too full and around off, Amy drives off the front foot but finds extra cover.
Fullish and on off, pushed to covers.
Loopy and outside off, left alone.
Fuller and around off, driven through the line to covers.
EDGED BUT SAFE! A nervy start for Amy. Full and flighted outside off, turning away, Amy Satterthwaite tries to drive but gets a thick outside edge. It runs wide of slip and they take two runs.
Amy Satterthwaite comes to the crease now.

OUT! What a catch! Great reward for Sneh Rana for bowling some consistent lines. She delivers it a touch short and around middle, skidding in, Sophie Devine goes deep inside the crease to perhaps hit it across the line. The bounce though gets big on her bat and takes the outer half. It loops towards point where Rajeshwari Gayakwad runs forward and dives to secure the catch. The dangerous stand is broken.
Commentary.Howout: c Rajeshwari Gayakwad b Sneh Rana

Commentary.Commentary: Nice loop on this one, full and around off, it's driven to long off for a single.
Tossed up, landing full and around off, Amelia Kerr kneels and slogs it over mid-wicket for one.
Presses forward and pushes a full ball with the spin to covers.

SAFE! A touch quicker through the air, perhaps a googly around off, Devine punches it to covers and scampers across to the other end. The fielder scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but Sophie is found to be safe in the replays.
Is that a run out? There is a direct throw at the bowler's end. The replays roll and show that the batter is well in her crease. NOT OUT says the third umpire!
Turn and bounce outside off, it's left alone by the batter.
Slower and shorter outside off, turning away, Kerr goes back and punches it past the cover fielder for a single.
Poonam Yadav comes into the attack.
Quicker and fuller on off, Kerr eases it down to long on for another run. Three good overs for India Women.
Fuller and on off, Devine drives it down through mid on for a single.
A bit frustrating for Sophie Devine - She plays another drive but finds the mid off fielder.
Fuller and outside off, Sophie drives again but find the cover fielder.
Floated one, full and outside off, Devine mistimes her drive to covers.
Flighted and full around off, Amelia Kerr strokes it down to long on for a run.
Another sweep shot to a full ball by Kerr as she sends it to deep square leg for a single.
Width there outside off, it's forced to deep cover for one.
Loopy and full outside off, Amelia Kerr sweeps it along the ground to deep square leg for a single.
Short and wide outside off, cut to point.
Flatter and shorter on off, punched to sweeper cover for one.
Fuller and on off, knocked down to long on for a single.
Quicker now, outside off, on a fuller length. Amelia Kerr pushes it towards covers for a single. Good start from Sneh Rana! Just 2 runs off her first over!
Tosses it up, full in length, outside off. Amelia Kerr pushes it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball now, fuller. Amelia Kerr leans and defends it out.
Beauty! Quicker now, shorter, outside off. Amelia Kerr looks to block this but gets beaten on the outside edge due to some extra bounce. The ball has just missed the off pole as well!
Shorter now, around middle, Sophie Devine works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Sneh Rana begins with a loopy ball, full and on middle. Sophie Devine leans and blocks it out.

Drinks break. The players take a moment to rehydrate themselves. It's been a steady start from the home team despite losing Suzie Bates cheaply. The ongoing stand has shown good intent and the pair of Sophie Devine and Amelia Kerr is looking quite positive. India Women need to pick wickets in the middle phase if they want to avoid chasing a big total here. Sneh Rana to bowl after the break.
Tad shorter, outside off, much slower this time. Amelia Kerr punches it towards mid off.
Flighted ball, outside off. Sophie Devine has cut this away towards point. Single taken!
Short in length now, outside off. Sophie Devine stays in her crease and punches it towards cover. No run there!
Loopy ball, full, on middle. Amelia Kerr gets down her knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
Shorter ball, outside off, turning it away. Sophie Devine pushes it towards cover for a single.
Tosses it up on middle, fuller ball. Amelia Kerr sweeps it towards deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Another boundary of the over! Fuller now, on middle. Sophie Devine sweeps it towards deep square leg for a boundary. The 50-run stand comes up, off 49 balls.
Fuller ball, turning it in on middle. Amelia Kerr tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Perfectly placed! Shorter ball now, outside off, Amelia Kerr hangs back and smashes it past cover for a boundary!
Floats this one up, full, around middle, Amelia Kerr leans and taps it towards mid-wicket.
Loopy ball again, outside off. Amelia Kerr chops it towards third man for a couple of runs.
Tosses it up, fuller in length, outside off, Sophie Devine pats it towards cover for a single.
Shorter again, outside off, Sophie Devine dabs it towards cover for a single.
Short in length, outside off. Amelia Kerr cuts it off the back foot towards point for a single.
Loopy ball, on middle and full in length. Amelia Kerr leans and defends it out.
Short again, outside off. Amelia Kerr stays in her crease and plays it towards sweeper cover for a brace.
Shorter this time, on middle. Amelia Kerr steps down the pitch and plays it towards mid on.
Fine leg comes up. Mid on drops back.
Deepti Sharma begins with a fuller ball, outside the off pole. Sophie Devine pushes it towards deep cover and rotates the strike!
Change in bowling. Deepti Sharma to have a go now.
Tosses this one up, full and outside off. Amelia Kerr pushes it to the fielder at cover-point.
Shorter now, quicker as well, outside off. Amelia Kerr hangs back and cuts it towards cover.
FOUR! Nicely played! Full again, slower through the air. Amelia Kerr gets down on her knee and sweeps it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Loopy ball, full and outside off, Amelia Kerr leans and blocks it out.
Fuller ball, outside off. Sophie Devine cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
SIX! Welcome to the attack, Rajeshwari Gayakwad! A shorter ball, on middle, Sophie Devine swivels and pulls it over deep square leg for a biggie! 50 up for the White Ferns in style.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes into the attack.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over. Rajeshwari Gayakwad is into the attack now.
Width there outside off, Devine chops it down and the ball goes to deep cover for a single. At the end of Powerplay 1, New Zealand Women are 49/1.
Fullish and on off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
A yorker, dipping in around off, Amelia Kerr digs it out from the bottom half of her bat and it goes wide of the slip fielder for a single.
Fuller in length and around off, Devine drives it to the right of backward point. Smriti Mandhana dives to make the stop but cannot prevent the single.
Short and close to off, Sophie Devine tries to guide it down to third man but finds the gully fielder.
Back of a length on off, it's punched from the back foot to covers.
Wide! Short in length and wide outside off, an outswinger, the batter leaves.
Outside off, played down to point.
Fuller and around off, it's pushed back to the bowler who doesn't stop it but Shafali Verma comes running across to her left to make the stop.

EDGY FOUR! A little bit of inward movement there for Goswami as she lands it on a good length around off, Amelia Kerr sticks back to play at it but gets a big inside edge. It flies over the stumps and wide of the diving keeper for a boundary at fine leg.
An inswinger is served on a length around off, Amelia Kerr defends from the back foot to covers.
Angling in from a length outside off, Kerr defends it gently to the off side.
Fuller in length and closer to off, Amelia Kerr is on the front foot as she pushes it from the outer half to backward point.
Quite wide outside off, an outswinger just inside the tramline, Sophie Devine allows it through.
Pitches it up and around off, inviting the drive, Sophie does that with a straight bat but finds mid off.
Too close to cut, Sophie still tries but only manages to chop it down on one bounce to first slip.
Back of a length, around off, Devine goes on her toes and attempts to run it down to third man. But she finds the slip fielder.
Fuller in length, wide outside off, it's driven wide of backward point for a single.
In the zone outside off, Kerr defends it to the cover region.
Wide called for height! A bumper around off, Kerr allows it through over her head.

EDGED BUT SAFE! Jhulan Goswami delivers it full and around off, shaping away late, Amelia Kerr is forward to defend but gets a soft outside edge. It doesn't carry to the first slip fielder and gets palmed away behind the keeper. They cross.
Beaten! On a good length, close to the off stump line, Kerr tries to cut but misses.

FOUR! Superbly done! Short in length and around middle, Amelia Kerr rides the bounce, rolls her wrists on the pull shot and places it all along the ground through backward square leg for a boundary. This shot shows that she is in prime form.

Width there outside off, Sophie Devine chops it down wide of backward point. They cross for a couple of runs as Poonam Yadav throws it to the fielder at backward point. She has a shy at the bowler's end, misses and the backup fielder also fumbles. Another run taken.
Pitches it up again, around off, Sophie Devine is forward as she strokes it to mid off again.
An inswinger, landing full and around off, Devine gets forward and pushes it to mid off.
Fuller and around leg, it's worked in front of square leg with gentle hands. Two runs taken and Amelia Kerr opens her account.
On a length and outside off, Kerr plays it down late past gully but the backward point fielder has it covered.
Gets forward to a full ball and drives it towards mid off.
Another wide, this time wide outside off. An outswinger is delivered too wide. Amelia allows it through.
Wide! Full again, around leg and this one goes on with the angle. Kerr tries flicking but misses.
Amelia Kerr walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! Plumb in front! Meghna gets the big wicket of Suzie Bates. She delivers it full and around leg, it lands and straightens as Bates walks forward to flick it on the leg side. She misses, gets rapped on the pads, they appeal and the umpire has no hesitation in lifting the finger. That's a big breakthrough for India Women.
Fullish and around off, landing and seaming away, Sophie slices her drive in the gap at cover-point for a single.
Short in length, outside off, Devine chops her attempted square cut on the bounce to the point fielder.
Full once again, outside off. Suzie Bates pushes it to covers off the front foot. Dot to end the over!
On a length, on middle. Suzie Bates presents the full face of her bat and blocks it out.
Fuller now, outside off. Suzie Bates leans and pushes it to mid off.
Beauty! On a length, shaping away, outside off. Suzie Bates looks to block this but gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! Top shot! Jhulan Goswami servers a fuller ball again, around middle and leg. Suzie Bates uses her wrists and flicks it past mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller ball, around middle, Suzie Bates works it away towards mid on. No run there!
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Full again, outside off. Sophie Devine leans and smashes this past cover for a cracking boundary.
Length ball, on the pads. Suzie Bates flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Fuller now, around middle, Suzie Bates pushes it to mid on.
Beaten! A beauty this time! On a length, shaping away, outside off. Suzie Bates looks to push this away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Edged...and in the gap! A fuller ball, outside off. Sophie Devine drives but gets an outside edge past gully for a single.
Much better now! It's a gem from Meghna Singh. She delivers it on a fuller length around off, Sophie Devine gets forward to drive it down the ground but it nips away late to beat the outside edge.
Wide! Another one down the leg side, full length. Sophie Devine once again misses her flick and a wide is given!
Wide! Fuller ball, down the leg side. Sophie Devine misses her flick. Wide called!

Good fielding! Fuller ball, outside off. Suzie Bates drives it towards the right of the fielder at mid off. The fielder there dives to her right and stops the ball from going to the boundary. Two runs taken!
On a length, outside off. Suzie Bates pushes it back to the bowler off the inner half of her blade.
Tad fuller again, outside off. Suzie Bates dabs it towards gully.
Full again, outside off. Suzie Bates pushes it towards mid off. No run taken!
FOUR! Glorious! Back-to-back boundaries! Fuller now, outside off. Suzie Bates drives it past mid off for a boundary.

FOUR! First boundary of the innings! A shorter one now, down the leg side. Suzie Bates goes for the pull shot but she gets gloves onto it and the ball runs wide of the keeper to find the fence at fine leg.
Meghna Singh ends her first over with a full ball, outside off. Suzie Bates chops it into the deck and the ball bounces over the fielder at gully for a single.
Another full-length delivery, angling it in on middle. Suzie Bates pushes it to mid on. No run there!
Full again, outside the off pole. Suzie Bates drives it towards mid off. Dot ball!
Full in length, shaping away from outside off. Sophie Devine drives it towards deep cover for a single.
On a length, outside off. Suzie Bates pushes it past cover-point for a single. Suzie Bates gets off the mark!
Meghna Singh starts with a full ball, outside off. Suzie Bates drives but finds the fielder at mid off.
Meghna Singh to operate from the other end. One slip remains...
Good-length delivery, outside off. Sophie Devine pushes it towards gully. 1 run off the first over!
Length ball, outside off. Sophie Devine blocks it out.

Leg bye! Full-length delivery, drifting it in on the pads. Suzie Bates looks to flick but misses. The ball deflects off the pads and rolls towards short fine leg. A leg bye is taken! New Zealand Women are up and running!
Beaten! Good-length delivery, outside off, a hint of away movement. Suzie Bates looks to block this but misses.
Fuller now, around middle. Suzie Bates pushes it towards the fielder at mid on.
Jhulan Goswami begins with a length ball, outside off. Suzie Bates taps it towards cover-point.

It's time to get underway! The players of India Women have spread on the ground. The sun is out in its full glory and the conditions are looking ripe for batting. Suzie Bates and Sophie Devine are the openers for the White Ferns. All in readiness, here is Jhulan Goswami...

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Mithali Raj (C), Deepti Sharma, Harmanpreet Kaur (In for Yastika Bhatia), Richa Ghosh (WK), Sneh Rana, Jhulan Goswami (In for Pooja Vastrakar), Meghna Singh, Rajeshwari Gayakwad, Poonam Yadav (In for Renuka Singh).

New Zealand Women (Playing XI) - Suzie Bates, Sophie Devine (C), Amelia Kerr, Amy Satterthwaite, Lauren Down, Katey Martin (WK), Hayley Jensen, Frances Mackay, Hannah Rowe, Rosemary Mair, Fran Jonas (In for Jess Kerr).
TOSS - New Zealand Women have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

India Women, on the other hand, have failed to prove their worth. They have the quality in their ranks but they have been unable to outplay the hosts. They will want to win the final game and end the series on a high, which in turn will help them gain some kind of confidence before the ICC Women's World Cup. Like every other game, this too promises to be a thriller. Stay tuned for the toss and team news.

New Zealand Women seem like a formidable unit. They have been performing as a team, we have seen different players stepping up on different occasions and helping them clinch the previous games. They will be hoping they can replicate the same in the last game of the series and clean sweep India Women.

Hello and a warm welcome to the fifth and the final ODI of this exciting series between New Zealand Women and India Women. White Ferns have taken an unassailable 4-0 lead in this series, while Indian Women have not been able to get over the line yet. However, they will be hoping to win the last ODI and end this series on a positive note. We saw the previous game get cut short due to rain, but let's hope the rain does not interrupt today and we get to witness a full game!
... MATCH DAY ...
